note: Format of the TEF and TEF Canada, shown on /tef. Structure only, written from the public descriptions of CCI Paris Île-de-France (cci-paris-idf.fr, lefrancaisdesaffaires.fr) and secondary sources; none of it could be checked against a current official paper, so every figure is marked 'to verify' on the page. No exam content is reproduced. Prices are not given.

formate.source: Public descriptions of CCI Paris Île-de-France; figures to verify with your test centre, November 2026
formate.intro: A French test taken at an approved centre, on paper or on a computer depending on the centre (to verify). Four papers are standard; a fifth, on vocabulary and structure, is an option in some versions (to verify). Each paper gets a score, and the scores are matched to the levels of the CEFR scale.

formate.intro: The version of the TEF accepted for Canadian immigration and citizenship procedures. Its four papers are all compulsory, and the scores are also converted to the Canadian levels (NCLC). Which test and which levels your own application needs is set by the Canadian authorities: check their current rules (to verify).
